title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.02074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. translated_title: 同态优势算子：在全同态加密约束下稳定强化学习
translated_abstract: 隐私保护的机器学习对于拥有机密数据的智能系统在云端部署提出了重大挑战。全同态加密（FHE）为安全计算提供了一种极具吸引力的解决方案，能够保护云计算中数据的机密性。然而，将FHE应用于强化学习（RL）需要用多项式近似替代非线性运算，而这会由于一种独特的递归误差现象——贝尔曼漂移（Bellman drift）——而发生灾难性发散。本文提出了同态优势算子（HAO），这是一个旨在防止基于FHE的深度强化学习中多项式近似发散的稳定化框架。HAO将源自基于优势的价值估计方法的零均值中心化投影直接应用于时序差分（TD）目标。这种线性投影消除了驱动贝尔曼漂移的均匀状态价值基线，同时保持各状态下动作的排序…
tldr: 本文提出同态优势算子（HAO），通过将零均值中心化投影直接应用于时序差分目标来消除引发贝尔曼漂移的状态价值基线，从而防止基于全同态加密的深度强化学习中多项式近似的灾难性发散。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), which applies the zero-mean centering projection directly to temporal-difference targets to annihilate the state-value baseline driving the Bellman drift, thereby preventing catastrophic divergence of polynomial approximations in fully homomorphic encryption-based deep reinforcement learning.
